label: Restart Web Workers (Dev Appliances Only)
mcp_tool_description: Recycle CloudBolt's web worker processes so a UI extension (XUI) you just synced loads its new routes and views, instead of asking a human to run systemctl restart httpd. For DEVELOPMENT appliances only: it works on any appliance it is synced to, and requires a CloudBolt admin caller. Set dev_web_restart_dry_run to true to list the workers without restarting them. dev_web_restart_mode is rolling (default) or all. Rolling recycles one worker at a time and waits for each to finish importing before the next, so the portal keeps answering; for a few minutes some requests may still hit old-code workers (a new extension route can 404 until the roll finishes) and a request in flight on the worker being recycled is cut off. All restarts every worker at once: faster, but the web tier is unavailable for the whole re-import window, so MCP and UI calls fail briefly and should be retried. Returns a job id to poll with fetch_job_log; the output has mode, perWorker, totalSeconds, oldWorkerPids, newWorkerPids, signalledCount and the HTTP probe result. Never use on a production appliance.
